engine.sample_rate_source: docs/DECISIONS-v1.md DEC-009 (project pin). Dexed itself is host-rate-driven; 48000 is applied via the wrapper as prepareToPlay(48000.0), which initializes Freqlut, Lfo, PitchEnv, Env and PluginFx (Source/PluginProcessor.cpp prepareToPlay).

settings.name: engine_type
settings.note: Selected in DexedAudioProcessor constructor; oracle must use EngineMkI, not EngineOpl or the modern FmCore path.

settings.name: sample_rate
settings.note: Wrapper-defined input to prepareToPlay; Dexed has no built-in default rate.

settings.name: max_active_notes
settings.note: MAX_ACTIVE_NOTES = 16; voice allocation order is part of the render path the R02 wrapper must replicate.

settings.name: engine_block_size
settings.note: LG_N = 6, N = 64: internal per-note render block of msfa/Dexed; processBlock handles buffers not a multiple of N via extra_buf.

settings.name: controllers_defaults
settings.value: amp_mod = pitch_mod = eg_mod = 0; opSwitch = "111111"; transpose12AsScale = true; mpeEnabled = true; mpePitchBendRange = 24
settings.note: Controllers::Controllers constructor plus the C++ default member initializers in the same header. mpeEnabled is render-relevant: it changes MPE channel/note matching in processMidiMessage and keydown (Source/PluginProcessor.cpp) and pitch handling (Source/msfa/dx7note.cc line 235). The R02 oracle must run with these constructor defaults.

settings.name: mod_wheel_default_modifiers
settings.note: FmMod::FmMod default; applies to wheel, foot, breath, at (all four default-constructed the same).

settings.name: mono_mode
settings.note: DexedAudioProcessor constructor: monoMode = 0 (polyphonic); monoMode branches keydown voice allocation (Source/PluginProcessor.cpp keydown).

settings.name: fx_defaults
settings.note: PluginFx::PluginFx defaults; at maximum cutoff the LPF is bypassed (PluginFx::process). Dry comparison renders keep these defaults.

settings.name: tuning
settings.note: StandardTuning uses base = 50857777 ((1 << 24) * (log(440) / log(2) - 69/12)); DexedAudioProcessor constructor calls createStandardTuning(). The constructor also registers an MTS-ESP client (MTS_RegisterClient, Source/PluginProcessor.cpp); with no MTS-ESP master connected MTS_HasMaster is false, so retuning and MTS note filtering are inactive (Source/PluginProcessor.cpp processBlock/processMidiMessage). The oracle build links libs/MTS-ESP/Client (pinned in files) and runs with no MTS master: confirmed behavior is R02's responsibility.

settings.name: sysex_echo
settings.note: Plugin sysex echo is a host/UI path (Source/SysexComm.*), outside the engine render path. The headless oracle has no MIDI in/out; echo is structurally absent.

settings.name: render_scaling
settings.value: int32 accumulate -> >>4 -> clip to +/- (1<<24) -> >>9 -> /0x8000 -> float, clamped to [-1, 1]; mono output copied to both channels
settings.note: DexedAudioProcessor::processBlock per-note conversion; the R02 wrapper must replicate this exactly. Output remains dry: no normalization.

settings.name: block_event_scheduling
settings.note: Host block size and MIDI event placement follow DexedAudioProcessor::processBlock / getNextEvent semantics; exact block sizes are fixed by the R02 wrapper and echoed in render metadata.

patch_struct_note: The engine consumes voice state from Dexed's internal uint8_t data[161] (Source/PluginProcessor.h). Verified layout facts: a DX7 single-voice dump is copied verbatim into data[0..154] (memcpy(data, rawdata, 155), Source/PluginData.cpp updateProgramFromSysex), so data[0..154] are the packed DX7 single-voice bytes (data[134] algorithm, data[135] feedback, data[136] osc key sync per the CtrlDX offsets in Source/PluginParam.cpp initCtrl; data[137..] LFO block per lfo.reset(data + 137) in Source/PluginData.cpp); data[136] gates oscSync at keydown (Source/PluginProcessor.cpp keydown: if (data[136]) ... oscSync()); data[155] holds the packed operator-switch byte, which is not part of a sysex cartridge and is rendered by packOpSwitch (Source/PluginParam.cpp setDxValue); data[156..160] are Dexed-internal state. Dx7Note::init(const uint8_t patch[156], ...) consumes the first 156 entries (Source/msfa/dx7note.h). The P01 sysex codec (src/gf180_dx7/sysex.py) owns DX7 sysex framing; the .syx -> data[161] mapping for the oracle is wrapper-defined in R02.

toolchain.purpose: Compiler/runtime used to build and run the external oracle (R02). Recorded at manifest time on the pin machine.

python_runtime_of_record.note: Recorded for reproducibility. tools/verify_reference.py is stdlib-only and does not hard-fail on a newer Python; the R02 oracle build/runtime pin is enforced there.

toolchain.drift_rule: A different clang++ version line than toolchain.cxx_compiler.version_line is drift: verify_reference.py reports it and exits 1. Re-pinning the toolchain requires a manifest change and review, never a silent follow.

oracle_protocol.status: Interface I/O contract is defined in reference/oracle-protocol.md; the executable wrapper that implements it is defined by R02 (issue R02). The GPL oracle code lives OUTSIDE this repository; this repository stores only the protocol, hashes, and evidence.

exit_codes.0: PASS: pinned commit, every file hash, and toolchain match
exit_codes.1: FAIL (drift): commit mismatch, file missing/modified, or toolchain mismatch; first mismatch reported explicitly
exit_codes.2: NOT_RUN (environment/usage): missing or unusable --dexed-root, missing git, or invalid manifest

rules: Any hash or commit mismatch aborts; the verifier never updates the manifest or follows upstream.
A pinned value may change only by editing the manifest, re-running the verifier, and review; pin changes are STALE-marked per DEC-001 change control.
verify_reference.py is re-run by tools/check_all.sh whenever the local Dexed clone exists; where the clone is absent the check is NOT_RUN (guarded skip), never reported as PASS.
